meta.note: Client behaviour was read from the linked vendor documentation on the verifiedOn date.

clients.name: Claude Desktop
limitations: The JSON file only configures local processes. Remote servers are added through the connector settings screen instead.
The app must be fully quit and reopened before it picks up a config change.
Environment variables in the file are stored in plain text, so treat the file as a secret.

clients.name: Claude Code
limitations: Project scoped servers prompt for approval the first time a teammate runs them.
Secrets belong in your shell environment rather than in a committed .mcp.json.

clients.name: ChatGPT and the OpenAI API

configPaths.path: Settings, then Connectors, then create a custom connector
Responses API request body, tools array

limitations: Local stdio servers cannot be attached. The server must be reachable over HTTPS.
Custom connectors in ChatGPT sit behind developer mode and are not available on every plan.
The server must handle its own authentication, because there is no local environment block to inject secrets into.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
limitations: Streamable HTTP uses httpUrl while SSE uses url. Mixing them silently selects the wrong transport.
Setting trust to true skips the per call confirmation, which is convenient and also removes a safety net.

clients.name: Cursor
limitations: A tool count ceiling applies across all enabled servers, so large bridge connectors can crowd out others.
Committed project files should reference environment variables rather than literal keys.

clients.name: VS Code with GitHub Copilot

configPaths.path: Command palette, MCP: Open User Configuration

limitations: The top level key is servers, not mcpServers. Configuration copied from another client will not load.
Agent mode must be enabled for tools to be offered to the model.

clients.name: Windsurf
limitations: Remote servers use serverUrl. A block copied from Cursor or Claude will not connect.
Cascade counts tools against a per conversation budget, so trim large servers.

clients.name: Codex CLI
limitations: The configuration format is TOML. JSON snippets from other clients must be translated.
Support for remote servers arrived later than stdio support, so keep the CLI current.

clients.name: Zed
limitations: The key is context_servers and each entry needs a source field, so other clients configuration does not transfer.
Local processes only. A remote HTTPS server needs a local bridge process in front of it.
